headword: {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}
gloss: marriage hunting; actively seeking a spouse

definitions.gloss: marriage hunting; actively seeking a spouse
definitions.explanation: Deliberate effort to find a marriage partner, such as attending matchmaking events, using dating services, or being introduced to prospects. The full form of the common abbreviation {婚活|こんかつ}.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}は{結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: My sister has started marriage hunting.

examples.japanese: {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}のために{相談所|そうだんじょ}に{登録|とうろく}した。
examples.english: I registered with an agency for my marriage hunting.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{忙|いそが}しくて、なかなか{結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}に{時間|じかん}が{取|と}れない。
examples.english: I'm so busy with work that I can hardly find time for marriage hunting.

notes:
The full form of {婚活|こんかつ}, formed from {結婚|けっこん} (marriage) + {活動|かつどう} (activity), on the model of {就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう} (job hunting). In everyday use the abbreviation {婚活|こんかつ} is far more common; the full form sounds slightly more formal or explanatory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}を{始|はじ}める: to start marriage hunting
- {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}に{励|はげ}む: to work hard at finding a spouse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {婚活|こんかつ}: marriage hunting — the standard abbreviation; identical meaning
- {就活|しゅうかつ}: job hunting — the parallel abbreviation for finding employment
